title: Postgres rejects connections: too many clients
log_text:
2025-05-02T08:00:12Z ERROR search-api startup failed
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/search/db.py", line 19, in connect
    conn = psycopg2.connect(DSN)
psycopg2.OperationalError: connection to server at "10.0.4.20", port 5432 failed: FATAL:  sorry, too many clients already
root_cause: Each of 30 pods opens a pool of 20 connections, exceeding Postgres max_connections=500 after a scale-out; new pods are refused at startup.
fix: Put PgBouncer (transaction pooling) in front of Postgres, cut per-pod pool_size to 5, and alert when connections exceed 80% of max_connections.

title: Query cancelled by statement_timeout after table growth
log_text:
2025-04-14T11:30:45Z ERROR reports-api GET /reports/monthly failed
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/reports/queries.py", line 64, in monthly_totals
    cur.execute(MONTHLY_SQL, params)
psycopg2.errors.QueryCanceled: canceling statement due to statement timeout
root_cause: The monthly report filters events by (account_id, created_at) but there is no composite index; after the events table passed 80M rows the sequential scan exceeded the 15s statement_timeout.
fix: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON events (account_id, created_at); confirm with EXPLAIN ANALYZE; add slow-query logging (log_min_duration_statement = 2000).

title: Redis OOM: writes rejected at maxmemory
log_text:
2025-03-08T19:02:33Z ERROR cart-service add_item failed

  File "/app/cart/store.py", line 44, in add_item
    self.redis.hset(cart_key, sku, qty)
redis.exceptions.ResponseError: OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.
root_cause: Cart keys were written without a TTL and the eviction policy was noeviction, so abandoned carts accumulated until Redis hit maxmemory and rejected all writes.
fix: Set EXPIRE on cart keys (7 days), switch maxmemory-policy to volatile-lru, and alert on used_memory / maxmemory > 85%.

root_cause: A nightly cleanup job ran KEYS session:* against 12M keys, blocking Redis's single thread for seconds so every other client's reads timed out.
fix: Replace KEYS with SCAN using COUNT 1000, rename-command KEYS in production, and check SLOWLOG GET for other blocking commands.

root_cause: The service was deployed to a new namespace, but the Secret holding DATABASE_URL existed only in the old namespace, so envFrom injected nothing and the app exited at import.

root_cause: The batch job requested 4 CPUs per pod while the node group was already at its autoscaler maximum, so new pods could not be scheduled.

log_text: botocore.exceptions.ClientError: An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the PutObject operation: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/report-exporter-role/i-0abc is not authorized to perform: s3:PutObject on resource: "arn:aws:s3:::acme-reports/2025/06/summary.csv" with an explicit deny in a resource-based policy
root_cause: The bucket policy was tightened to deny any request not coming through the VPC endpoint (aws:SourceVpce condition); the exporter ran in a subnet whose route table had no S3 gateway endpoint.

title: DynamoDB throttling from hot partition key
log_text:
2025-03-30T18:20:11Z ERROR events-ingest write failed after 10 retries
botocore.errorfactory.ProvisionedThroughputExceededException: An error occurred (ProvisionedThroughputExceededException) when calling the PutItem operation (reached max retries: 9): The level of configured provisioned throughput for the table was exceeded.
root_cause: The partition key was the event date, so all writes for the day hit one partition and exceeded its per-partition limit even though table-level capacity was available.
fix: Change the key to a high-cardinality value (e.g. tenant_id#date with a shard suffix), switch to on-demand capacity during the migration, and watch the ThrottledRequests metric.

title: Kafka producer errors during broker rolling restart
log_text:
2025-05-07 02:10:33,412 ERROR o.a.k.c.p.i.Sender - [Producer clientId=orders-producer] Got error produce response with correlation id 88123 on topic-partition orders-3, retrying (0 attempts left). Error: NOT_LEADER_OR_FOLLOWER
org.apache.kafka.common.errors.NotLeaderOrFollowerException: For requests intended only for the leader, this error indicates that the broker is not the current leader.
root_cause: The producer was configured with retries=0, so messages sent during a planned broker rolling restart (while partition leadership moved) were dropped instead of retried.
fix: Use producer defaults for durability: retries=MAX_INT, delivery.timeout.ms=120000, acks=all, enable.idempotence=true; roll brokers one at a time with controlled shutdown.

ERROR [alembic.util.messaging] Multiple head revisions are present for given argument 'head'; please specify a specific target revision, '<branchname>@head' to narrow to a specific head, or 'heads' for all heads
FAILED: Multiple head revisions are present for given argument 'head'
root_cause: Two feature branches each added a migration with the same down_revision; after both merged, the migration graph had two heads and the deploy's `alembic upgrade head` refused to run.
fix: Create a merge revision (`alembic merge heads -m 'merge'`), and add a CI check that fails when `alembic heads` returns more than one revision.
